speaker: john_heminges
text: The king, for the sixth time. A full house, and a raw day to bring them in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sixth. The jaw held. I was done at the second act, and the door was enough.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The door was enough. They stayed. I could hear them with you standing in the way of the crack.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Gowns, citizens, two bishops' men. And at the back of the twopenny room an old great gentleman in a frieze cloak, with two fellows who'd liefer have been anywhere. Paid for three. Swore under his breath from the castle on, good round oaths, and at the prison he blew his nose like a sackbut.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Paid for three. I will have that in the box, and nowhere else. I do not know a frieze cloak by name.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A country justice, up for the term. That is as far as a guess goes, and it is only a guess.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Did he clap?

speaker: margery_pell
text: He struck the rail with his fist. I took it for clapping.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it was clapping. I am not making a patron of a fist.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nor a part. The book we played is the book. I am not opening another copy.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is. A raw day, a full house, and three paid for at the back. That is the report.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And a nose like a sackbut. I shall try not to build a friendship on it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Be grateful for the three. The oaths were free. I am not charging the house for them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going home when this is said. One candle will do the rest of my day. I have nothing to add to a justice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go when you are ready. The box is the box. We will not think further than the cloak.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have the sixth in the margin, and the three. I do not have a name, and I am not leaving a blank for one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Keep it so. A name would be a guess with a hat on.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The stair is clear. If the cloak comes again I will know the cloth. I will not know more than the cloth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Rose had a title up. Barnardo. We did not cross. I have no receipt of theirs, and I am not going to read one I have not got.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: A bill is not a sum. Barnardo can stay on their door.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let them have their bill. We had the full house.

speaker: margery_pell
text: And gowns enough to keep me on the stair until the end. I am for my own fire.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And I for one candle. I am not walking the chamber to spend what the jaw already spent.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then sit to it. Tomorrow is Richard the Third, and you are in the duke's gown. Today is done.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Done, and unnamed. I like a margin better when it is short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Short is what it is. Good night.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Good night, sir. Mind the raw air. It was honest enough to keep the gowns on.
